text.hi: किताब का पहला सवाल: पिकनिक में रास्ता भटकने की घटना लिखो। शुरुआत किताब देती है: Once the members of my family and I went to a nearby riverside...
text.hinglish: Kitaab ka pehla sawaal: picnic mein raasta bhatakne ki ghatna likho. Shuruaat kitaab deti hai: Once the members of my family and I went to a nearby riverside...
text.en: The book's first task: write about a picnic where you lost your way. The book gives the start: Once the members of my family and I went to a nearby riverside...

prompt.hi: आगे लिखो: फिर हम जंगल में रास्ता भूल गए।
prompt.hinglish: Aage likho: phir hum jangal mein raasta bhool gaye.
prompt.en: Continue: say you lost your way in the forest.

steps.answer: Then we lost our way in the forest.

meaning.hi: फिर हम जंगल में रास्ता भूल गए।
meaning.hinglish: Phir hum jangal mein raasta bhool gaye.

prompt.hi: आगे लिखो: मेरी छोटी बहन डरकर रोने लगी।
prompt.hinglish: Aage likho: meri chhoti behen darkar rone lagi.
prompt.en: Continue: say your little sister got scared and started crying.

steps.answer: My little sister got scared and started crying.

meaning.hi: मेरी छोटी बहन डरकर रोने लगी।
meaning.hinglish: Meri chhoti behen darkar rone lagi.

prompt.hi: आगे लिखो: हमें एक चरवाहा मिला जिसने रास्ता बताया।
prompt.hinglish: Aage likho: humein ek charwaaha mila jisne raasta bataaya.
prompt.en: Continue: say you met a shepherd who showed the way.

steps.answer: We met a shepherd who showed us the way.

meaning.hi: हमें एक चरवाहा मिला जिसने हमें रास्ता दिखाया।
meaning.hinglish: Humein ek charwaaha mila jisne humein raasta dikhaaya.

prompt.hi: आगे लिखो: हम शाम तक सुरक्षित घर लौट आए।
prompt.hinglish: Aage likho: hum shaam tak surakshit ghar laut aaye.
prompt.en: Continue: say you came back home safely by evening.

steps.answer: We came back home safely by evening.

meaning.hi: हम शाम तक सुरक्षित घर लौट आए।
meaning.hinglish: Hum shaam tak surakshit ghar laut aaye.

text.hi: किताब का दूसरा सवाल: कृष्ण और डाकिया चाचा (रामलाल) की फ़ोन पर बातचीत पूरी करो। तुम कृष्ण बनो, मैं रामलाल बनता हूँ।
text.hinglish: Kitaab ka doosra sawaal: Krishan aur daakiya chacha (Ramlal) ki phone par baatcheet poori karo. Tum Krishan bano, main Ramlal banta hoon.
text.en: The book's second task: complete the phone talk between Krishan and Ramlal, the postman. You be Krishan; I'll be Ramlal.

replies.say: Hello, chacha, this is Krishan here from Dholpur.

meaning.hi: हेलो चाचा, मैं धौलपुर से कृष्ण बोल रहा हूँ।
meaning.hinglish: Hello chacha, main Dholpur se Krishan bol raha hoon.

turns.tinku: Hello, Krishan. This is Ramlal, the postman. What is it?

meaning.hi: हेलो कृष्ण, मैं रामलाल डाकिया। क्या बात है?
meaning.hinglish: Hello Krishan, main Ramlal daakiya. Kya baat hai?

replies.say: Can you please tell my parents that we will come back tomorrow?

meaning.hi: क्या आप मेरे माता-पिता को बता देंगे कि हम कल लौटेंगे?
meaning.hinglish: Kya aap mere maata-pita ko bata denge ki hum kal lautenge?

replies.say: We are at the fair. It's late.

meaning.hi: हम मेले में हैं। देर हो गई है।
meaning.hinglish: Hum mele mein hain. Der ho gayi hai.

turns.tinku: Why do you want to stay?
Good. I will pass the message on to your parents.

meaning.hi: ठीक है। मैं तुम्हारे माता-पिता को संदेश दे दूँगा।
meaning.hinglish: Theek hai. Main tumhare maata-pita ko sandesh de doonga.

steps.question: Ramlal tells Krishan's father: ‘Krishan called from ___.’

questionMeaning.hi: रामलाल कृष्ण के पिता से कहता है: ‘कृष्ण का फ़ोन ___ से आया।’
questionMeaning.hinglish: Ramlal Krishan ke pita se kehta hai: ‘Krishan ka phone ___ se aaya.’

steps.question: Why aren't the children coming back tonight?

questionMeaning.hi: बच्चे आज रात क्यों नहीं लौट रहे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bachche aaj raat kyon nahi laut rahe?

steps.modelAnswer: Ramlal said that they were not coming because the bus had broken down. They were all safe.

modelMeaning.hi: रामलाल ने बताया कि बस ख़राब होने की वजह से वे नहीं आ रहे। सब सुरक्षित हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Ramlal ne bataaya ki bus kharaab hone ki wajah se woh nahi aa rahe. Sab surakshit hain.
